title: YieldVault Webhook Envelope
description: The outbound envelope YieldVault sends for every webhook delivery. Source of truth: backend/src/webhookDelivery.ts (WebhookEnvelope).

schemaVersion.description: Monotonically increasing integer identifying the envelope shape. Consumers should gate feature detection on this field, not on the payload contents. Current value: 1.

sentAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this delivery attempt was dispatched.
